source_and_truth_gates.independent_cluster_unit: biological sample or accession lineage, never FASTQ file or edit count
source_and_truth_gates.assembly_and_reads: same accession/sample provenance verified; exact individual and DNA extraction uncertainties retained
source_and_truth_gates.read_molecule_identity: distinct original molecules or an explicitly provisional record-only tier
source_and_truth_gates.whole_reference_locus_check: map selected spanners to complete assembly; report primary, MAPQ, identity and secondaries
source_and_truth_gates.source_integrity: full size and SHA-256 plus complete gzip/FASTQ validation before use
source_and_truth_gates.truth: injected assembly bp difference only; physical copy truth evaluated separately
source_and_truth_gates.selection_order: freeze sample, assembly, candidate interval, edit geometry and denominator before inspecting read-supported score
source_and_truth_gates.denominator: all frozen cases including insufficient-read and intact controls

unchanged_frozen_read_span_rule.flank_hit_rule: one near-exact end-to-end hit per natural flank in correctly oriented read; ordered nonoverlapping hits
unchanged_frozen_read_span_rule.read_span: bp strictly between natural-flank hits; median over all eligible reads
unchanged_frozen_read_span_rule.assembly_span: direct natural-flank trim of edited FASTA; verify ledger only afterward
unchanged_frozen_read_span_rule.binary_discordance: abs(assembly_span_bp - median_read_span_bp) > max(2, ceil(0.05 * max(assembly_span_bp, median_read_span_bp)))
abstain_if: source integrity or provenance gate fails
assembly natural-flank trim is absent or nonunique
fewer than three distinct eligible reads or explicitly provisional records
after per-read exclusion for absent/nonunique flank or >10-bp CIGAR disagreement, fewer than three distinct eligible reads remain
unchanged_frozen_read_span_rule.coverage_rule: coverage is nominal sequenced bases divided by frozen assembly genome size; report actual local eligible-spanner count separately
unchanged_frozen_read_span_rule.coverage_subsampling: deterministic seeded whole-read selection, frozen before scoring; levels exceeding verified source coverage are not estimable, never upsample
unchanged_frozen_read_span_rule.confidence: no calibrated probability; output decision and explicit abstention reason

case_design.architecture_specific_changes: must be committed before opening the source's read-score result
case_design.correlated_edits: report clustered by original array and sample; never count edits as independent biological replicates

method_change_policy: any changed threshold or algorithm gets a new version and new held-out source clusters; these sources stay development data
